title: Largest Number
description: Given a list of non-negative integers `nums`, arrange them such that they form the largest number and return it as a string.

hints.content: Custom sort comparator: compare string concatenations (b + a) vs (a + b).
Edge case: if the highest number is "0", return "0".

solution.explanation:
Custom comparator sorting (b + a) against (a + b) greedily orders numbers to form the maximum combination.
Time Complexity: O(n log n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
